== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Zahn novels read before the shoot: the Insider 47 feature (ref fab) says the first three; the 2021 interview (ref mcrandle) says the first two before her second interview. Both kept as each source states.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Caption cut: "in the green costume" and "Official gallery caption: magazine feature \"Who is Mara Jade?\"" ([[:File:DecipherCon 2000 Who is Mara Jade.jpg]]); the feature title stays in the prose.
* Caption cut: oversized Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand is signed "Shannon Baksa as Mara Jade / San Diego."
* Duplicate cut from the Insider 47 section (kept once, in Likeness on SWCCG cards): Burns told Chernoff the green outfit was "meant to depict Mara's light side (which will be issued later as another Power Card in the game)." Decipher never printed that card; the Players Committee later used the photograph for Virtual Set 17. (ref fab)
* Quotes cut from the Light Side costume paragraph (ref set17, speakers not named in the article): extra shots "featured her in a green military jumpsuit. I'm pretty sure the plan for that was to be her Light Side version."; another designer: "The Light Side Mara Jade was unfortunate as the costume was made, Shannon was ready and it was shot. It just never made it onto a card (I don't know why)."; Virtual Set 17 is "a card some might say has been 20 years in the making."
* Databank quote replaced by a plain statement: "Decipher Inc. hired model Shannon Baksa to pose as Mara for a number of card images. Many subsequent products have since borne Baksa's likeness to represent Mara." (ref databank)
* PC quote cut from the card list: "Mrs. McRandle image also appears on the LS Card Mara Jade from V-Set 17." (ref pc-x)
* Interview framing cut (interviewer kept to the ref): brandon baity (NanashiStudios) posted ''Shannon McRandle (Mara Jade) Preview'' on 10 December 2021 (7 minutes 54 seconds). She is on camera from about 0:18. The title marks it as a preview. (ref mcrandle)

== Build notes (25 October 2026) ==
* Lead photo [[:File:Shannon Baksa as Mara Jade DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] is a crop of Decipher photo sat63 ([[:File:DecipherCon 1999 Mara Jade autograph.jpg]]). Identification is Bill Bisco's (25 October 2026). Decipher's caption calls the subject "Mara" but does not name Baksa; Lalumiere's Day 3 wrap-up places Baksa in full Mara Jade costume that Saturday.
* Other DecipherCon 1999 captions naming her: FRI fri27, fri67; SAT sat64, sat65. The sat64 large image was not archived.
